detail.command: set +e; echo ===HEAD===; git log --oneline -2; echo ===MARKERS===; git grep -n -E '^(<<<<<<<|=======|>>>>>>>)' -- src | head -5; echo MARKERS_DONE; echo ===TYPECHECK===; npm run typecheck > /tmp/c-tc.log 2>&1; echo TYPECHECK_EXIT=$?; tail -5 /tmp/c-tc.log; echo ===TEST_CAMERA===; npx vitest run src/camera > /tmp/c-cam.log 2>&1; echo CAMERA_EXIT=$?; grep -E 'Test Files|Tests |FAIL' /tmp/c-cam.log | head -10; echo ===TEST_UI===; npm run test:ui > /tmp/c-ui.log 2>&1; echo UI_EXIT=$?; grep -E 'Test Files|Tests |FAIL' /tmp/c-ui.log | head -10; echo ===TEST_INPUT===; npm run test:input > /tmp/c-in.log 2>&1; echo INPUT_EXIT=$?; grep -E 'Test Files|Tests |FAIL' /tmp/c-in.log | head -10; echo ===BUILD===; npm run build > /tmp/c-bd.log 2>&1; echo BUILD_EXIT=$?; tail -8 /tmp/c-bd.log; echo ===STATUS===; git status --short | head -20
